firewall_rules.description: ULTRA-SECURE firewall rules V3.1 - Dual communication with human control
firewall_rules.author: upgraded-happiness architecture - security hardened V3.1
firewall_rules._security_notice: 🔒 TODAS las reglas están configuradas para máxima seguridad V3.1 con comunicación dual

_risk_scoring_config.no_hardcoding_policy: 🔒 NINGÚN score debe estar hardcodeado en componentes - JSON manda siempre

rules.description: Riesgo muy bajo: Solo listar reglas activas para verificación
Riesgo bajo: Monitoreo básico de IP sospechosa

command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # MONITOR: echo 'pass log inet from {target_ip} to any' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # MONITOR: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='MONITOR-{command_id}' dir=in action=allow remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes

rules.description: Riesgo medio: Monitoreo intensivo con alertas

command_translation.linux_iptables: # ENHANCED_MONITOR: iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'ENHANCED_MONITOR-{command_id}' -j LOG --log-prefix 'FIREWALL_ALERT: ' && iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m limit --limit 10/min -j ACCEPT
command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # ENHANCED_MONITOR: echo 'pass log (all) inet from {target_ip} to any' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # ENHANCED_MONITOR: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='ENHANCED_MONITOR-{command_id}' dir=in action=allow remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes && netsh advfirewall set currentprofile logging allowedconnections enable

rules.description: Riesgo alto: Rate limiting para reducir capacidad de ataque
rules.disabled_reason: DEVELOPMENT MODE: Rate limiting disabled for safety

command_translation.linux_iptables: # RATE_LIMIT: iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'RATE_LIMIT-{command_id}' -m limit --limit {requests_per_minute}/min --limit-burst {burst_capacity} -j ACCEPT && iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -j DROP
command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # RATE_LIMIT: echo 'pass in inet from {target_ip} to any keep state (max 10, source-track rule, max-src-states {requests_per_minute})' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # RATE_LIMIT: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='RATE_LIMIT-{command_id}' dir=in action=allow remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes protocol=TCP localport=any

rules.description: Riesgo crítico: Bloqueo inmediato de IP maliciosa
rules.disabled_reason: DEVELOPMENT MODE: IP blocking disabled for safety

command_translation.linux_iptables: # BLOCK_IP: iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'BLOCK_IP-{command_id}' -j DROP && iptables -I FORWARD -s {target_ip} -j DROP
command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # BLOCK_IP: echo 'block drop in inet from {target_ip} to any' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # BLOCK_IP: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='BLOCK_IP-{command_id}' dir=in action=block remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes

manual_actions._comment: 🎛️ ACCIONES MANUALES - Ejecutadas desde dashboard con control humano

command_translation.windows_netsh: # LIST_RULES: netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name=all | findstr /C:'FIREWALL_'

command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # MANUAL_MONITOR: echo 'pass log inet from {target_ip} to any label "MANUAL_MONITOR-{command_id}"' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # MANUAL_MONITOR: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='MANUAL_MONITOR-{command_id}' dir=in action=allow remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes

RATE_LIMIT.description: Rate limiting - PELIGROSO - Solo con aprobación humana
RATE_LIMIT.disabled_reason: DEVELOPMENT MODE: Rate limiting disabled for safety - enable in production

command_translation.linux_iptables: # MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT: iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT-{command_id}' -m limit --limit {requests_per_minute}/min --limit-burst {burst_capacity} -j ACCEPT && iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT_DROP-{command_id}' -j LOG --log-prefix 'RATE_LIMITED: ' && iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -j DROP
command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT: echo 'pass in log inet from {target_ip} to any keep state (max {burst_capacity}, source-track rule, max-src-states {requests_per_minute}) label "MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT-{command_id}"' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='MANUAL_RATE_LIMIT-{command_id}' dir=in action=allow remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes protocol=any

BLOCK_IP.description: Bloquear IP - MUY PELIGROSO - Solo emergencias con confirmación múltiple
BLOCK_IP.disabled_reason: DEVELOPMENT MODE: IP blocking disabled for safety - enable only in production emergencies

command_translation.linux_iptables: # MANUAL_BLOCK_IP: iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'MANUAL_BLOCK_IP-{command_id}' -j LOG --log-prefix 'BLOCKED_IP: ' && iptables -I INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'MANUAL_BLOCK_IP-{command_id}' -j DROP && iptables -I FORWARD -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment 'MANUAL_BLOCK_IP_FWD-{command_id}' -j DROP
command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # MANUAL_BLOCK_IP: echo 'block drop in log inet from {target_ip} to any label "MANUAL_BLOCK_IP-{command_id}"' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # MANUAL_BLOCK_IP: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='MANUAL_BLOCK_IP-{command_id}' dir=in action=block remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes && netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='MANUAL_BLOCK_IP_OUT-{command_id}' dir=out action=block remoteip={target_ip} enable=yes

EMERGENCY_UNBLOCK.description: Desbloquear IP en emergencia - Para corregir errores de bloqueo

command_translation.linux_iptables: # EMERGENCY_UNBLOCK: iptables -D INPUT -s {target_ip} -m comment --comment '{target_rule_id}' -j DROP 2>/dev/null || echo 'Rule not found'
command_translation.darwin_pfctl: # EMERGENCY_UNBLOCK: pfctl -s rules | grep '{target_rule_id}' | sed 's/^/no /' | pfctl -f -
command_translation.windows_netsh: # EMERGENCY_UNBLOCK: netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name='{target_rule_id}'

_security_guarantees_v31.comprehensive_logging: All commands logged for security audit with origin tracking and translated commands
_security_guarantees_v31.fail_safe_design: When in doubt, chooses the most secure option
_security_guarantees_v31.dual_communication_safety: Independent channels prevent single point of failure
_security_guarantees_v31.human_oversight_guaranteed: Dashboard receives all scheduler actions for review
_security_guarantees_v31.command_traceability: Every action traced to scheduler or dashboard origin

_new_v31_guarantees.command_translation_visible: See exactly what firewall command would execute in dry_run

_new_v31_guarantees.development_safety: Dangerous actions disabled by default in development
_new_v31_guarantees.audit_trail_complete: Every decision logged with risk score, translated command, and outcome
